title: Abrego Garcia Will Voluntarily Leave U.S., Ending 20-Month Legal Ordeal
summary: Kilmar Armando Abrego Garcia, who was wrongfully deported last year, is leaving for Spain. He had faced the prospect that the Trump administration might deport him to Liberia.
